c5d51aa7c50818c5981fb74368a3a8e63e18cf15.summary: Forcepoint Security Labs reports that a trojanized RTF document tied to the Carbanak financially motivated criminal group ran VBScript malware that used Google Apps Script, Google Sheets and Google Forms for command-and-control, creating a unique spreadsheet per victim. The report says the Google channel was likely to succeed because such services are rarely blocked. It also mentions a Carbanak campaign called Digital Plagiarist that used weaponized office documents on mirrored hosts. Indicators list Cobalt Strike and Meterpreter DNS beacons.
